feed.title: Open MPC - Plugin Catalog: new releases

entry.title: Tuner 1.0.0
entry.summary: A chromatic tuner insert with a live needle drawn straight onto the MPC's screen at 20-24 fps: note, cents and Hz, A4 from 430 to 450 Hz, and a mute for silent tuning. It writes into MPC's display memory, which MPC OS doesn't offer plugins, so a firmware update could break it. Not affiliated with Akai.

entry.title: Stompbox 1.0.0
entry.summary: A whole guitar rig from guitarix's DSP: gate, comp, wah, any number of pedals, amp, tone stack, power amp, cabinet with an IR loader, post FX, mod, delay, reverb and EQ. 219 models and guitarix's 40 factory presets in the PRESET menu. Not affiliated with guitarix.

entry.title: NAM 1.0.10
entry.summary: Neural Amp Modeler captures as an insert effect, with cab IR, tone, gate, pitch, delay, reverb and an on-device TONE3000 downloader.

entry.title: MPC USB audio 1.1.1
entry.summary: The MPC as a USB audio interface: its outputs and inputs as channels on the computer, next to its MIDI ports.

entry.title: MPC Remote 1.1.1
entry.summary: The MPC screen in a browser, and an MCP server so an AI model can see and touch it, play MIDI and read files. Listens on the device only: reach it through an SSH tunnel (no login; bind=0.0.0.0 opens it to your network).

entry.title: MPC File Browser 1.0.1
entry.summary: FileBrowser Quantum beside MPC: browse the device's drives in a web browser, upload and download samples and projects, play audio, edit text files. Listens on the device only: reach it through an SSH tunnel (login admin / mpcadmin; change it). bind=0.0.0.0 opens it to your network.

entry.title: MPC Commander 1.1.1
entry.summary: The plugins MPC loads, with their own skins, and MPC's transport, on a desktop app. Listens on the device only: reach it through an SSH tunnel (no login; bind=0.0.0.0 opens it to your network).

entry.title: Monomodule One + FX 1.0.4
entry.summary: The Elektron Monomachine's synth engine (15 machines) as an instrument, plus its 7 effect machines as an audio effect, each with a touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

entry.title: Monomodule One (Gen2) 1.0.4
entry.summary: The Elektron Monomachine's synth engine (15 machines) as an instrument for Gen2 MPC devices, with a touchscreen skin, banks and preset lists, and Q-Links. A ready-made download: nothing of Elektron's is in the zip; you put your own Monomachine OS file in the plugin folder and it makes its skin and sound from that. Gen2 (aarch64) only.

entry.title: Monomodule FX (Gen2) 1.0.4
entry.summary: The Elektron Monomachine's seven effect machines (thru, reverb, chorus, dynamix, ring mod, phaser, flanger) as an audio effect for Gen2 MPC devices, with a touchscreen skin and Q-Links. A ready-made download with nothing of Elektron's in it: it reads your own Monomachine OS file from the plugin folder. Gen2 only.

entry.title: Machinemodule Tap (Gen2) 1.0.3
entry.summary: Puts any Machinemodule tracks, and its reverb and delay sends, on their own MPC return or FX track, so MPC's mixer and effects can process them. Needs Machinemodule in the same project. Gen2 (aarch64) only.

entry.title: Machinemodule (Gen2) 1.0.3
entry.summary: The Elektron Machinedrum UW sound engine as an instrument for Gen2 MPC devices: 16 tracks in one plugin, touchscreen skin, bank and kit lists, Q-Links. A ready-made download with nothing of Elektron's in it: you add your own OS file (and optionally your flash image) in the plugin folder. Gen2 only.

entry.title: Machinemodule 1.0.3
entry.summary: The Elektron Machinedrum SPS-1 UW sound engine as a native instrument: all 16 tracks from one plugin instance, with its own touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

entry.title: Keyscope 1.0.4
entry.summary: Listens to any track and names its key, chord, bass note and tuning, from the spectrum of the whole mix; the audio passes through untouched.

entry.title: Chordsmith 1.0.4
entry.summary: Chord tool: pads, keys or chord buttons play scale, set or custom chords with voicing, strum, arp and harp modes, MIDI out to other tracks and a built-in preview synth.

entry.title: Xenia 0.1.2
entry.summary: An emulation of the Microwave XT wavetable synthesizer's original firmware (gearmulator's 68k and DSP56300 emulators) as a native instrument for Gen2 MPC devices: ten touchscreen pages, ROM banks and patch browser, assignable play knobs and Q-Link control on every page. Gen2 (aarch64) only; you need your own Microwave XT ROM.

entry.title: Tuney 1.4.3
entry.summary: Real-time vocal pitch correction: key and scale or your own notes on a touch keyboard, a pitch dial, Retune, Transition, Amount, Vibrato and Humanize, voice ranges and a reference pitch. Presets from hard tune to subtle.

entry.title: Tropix 0.1.1
entry.summary: Island and afro ROMpler: 128 presets and 65 instruments for afrobeat, amapiano, kompa, soca, reggae and Hawaiian music - steel pans, log drums, saxes and trumpets, kompa and slack-key guitars, steels, keys, mallets, basses and percussion, from redistributable recordings and original synthesis. Two layers, glide, horn scoop, vibrato, nine colorways.

entry.title: Sonix 0.3.12
entry.summary: A melodic ROMpler instrument for standalone Akai MPC devices, built as a native ARM VST2 plugin. Includes pianos, keys, pads, strings, brass, choirs, leads, plucks, bass, bells, synth chords and effects, using redistributable sound libraries.

entry.title: Shapey EQ 1.6.2
entry.summary: An 8-band parametric EQ you shape by touch: tap or drag on the curve, drag numbered dots, and make any band a bell, shelf, cut, notch or band pass. Live analyzer, zero latency, presets and four themes.

entry.title: Shapey 5-Band EQ 1.0.1
entry.summary: The 5-band version of Shapey EQ, made for touch: every band has its own lane under a taller curve, so any dot drags directly. Any band can be a bell, shelf, cut, notch or band pass. Live analyzer, zero latency.

entry.title: Osirus 0.2.10
entry.summary: An emulation of the Access Virus A, B and C synthesizers' original firmware (gearmulator's DSP56300 emulator) as a native instrument for Gen2 MPC devices, with a touchscreen skin, banks and patch browser, Q-Link control and knob values on every page. Gen2 (aarch64) only; you need your own Virus ROM.

entry.title: Odin 2 1.4.6
entry.summary: Odin 2 synthesizer ported to standalone Akai MPC devices as a native VST2 plugin. Features Odin's original engine, 261 factory patches, touchscreen pages, automatic voice management and a CPU meter. Tested on an Akai MPC Live II; unofficial port.

entry.title: OB-Xd MPC 0.4.5
entry.summary: OB-Xd, the Oberheim OB-X emulation: two oscillators with sync and cross-mod, a 12/24 dB filter, voice variation; 128 presets.

entry.title: MPC Skipback 0.6.2
entry.summary: Records the main output all the time and saves the last 30 to 60 seconds as a WAV when you double-press a hardware button (Rec Arm on a Force; Overdub, or a button you teach it, on other models). Tested on a Gen1 Force; other models are unverified.

entry.title: MPC DJ FX 2 3.1.6
entry.summary: One-slot live DJ insert for MPC/Force: 3-band isolator, DJ filter, beat repeat, delay, reverb, through-zero flanger, grain delay, limiter, and eight performance macros measured from Lenny Kiser's DJ-FX rack.

entry.title: MPC DJ FX 2 3.1.5
entry.summary: One-slot live DJ insert for MPC/Force: 3-band isolator, DJ filter, beat repeat, delay, reverb, through-zero flanger, grain delay, limiter, and eight performance macros measured from Lenny Kiser's DJ-FX rack.

entry.title: Fretty 0.8.5
entry.summary: A guitar instrument for Akai MPC OS standalone devices (native VST2), featuring refined selector typography, 110 presets, and a synth layer.

entry.title: TR-MPC Tap FX 1.1.0
entry.summary: Companion to TR-MPC: sends any slot, or the kit's reverb or delay send, out on its own MPC track, sample-aligned with the kit, so MPC's mixer, submixes and insert effects can process it. Needs TR-MPC in the same project.

entry.title: TR-MPC 1.1.0
entry.summary: A modular 16-slot drum kit: each slot plays any of the 49 voices of athousanddetails' 6W6, 8W8, CW-78 and 9W9 (a 606 kick beside an 808 snare and 909 hats), with per-slot level, tune, decay, drive, pan and sends, one shared reverb, delay and master chain, a randomise module, and a touchscreen skin that reskins each slot to its voice's kit.

entry.title: Omni Sampler 1.8.1
entry.summary: Multi-format sampler: plays Akai, E-mu, Roland, Kontakt/Maschine, SF2 and SFZ instruments straight from their files or sampler disk images, with layers, keyswitching, a mod matrix and its own screen skin.

entry.title: MPC Tape Echo 1.2.3
entry.summary: Three-head tape echo with a spring tank: 12 head and reverb modes, tape saturation, wow and flutter, tempo sync, live VU.

entry.title: MPC Tape Echo 1.2.2
entry.summary: Three-head tape echo with a spring tank: 12 head and reverb modes, tape saturation, wow and flutter, tempo sync, live VU.

entry.title: MPC Multihead Echo 1.0.2
entry.summary: Three-head tape echo with three preamp characters, chorus, tape wear, tempo sync with drift, a spring reverb and a companion screen in the browser.

entry.title: CW-78 1.2.0
entry.summary: MPC/Force port of athousanddetails' schwung-CW-78 CR-78 drum machine: voices modelled from the 1979 service notes, with the preset rhythms. Touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

entry.title: 9W9 1.2.0
entry.summary: MPC/Force port of athousanddetails' schwung-9W9 TR-909 drum machine: circuit-modelled kick, snare, toms, rim and clap, with sampled hats, ride and crash (ER-99 derived), as on the original. Touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

entry.title: 8W8 1.2.0
entry.summary: MPC/Force port of athousanddetails' schwung-8W8 TR-808 drum machine: 15 of 16 voices circuit-modelled from the service notes. Touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

entry.title: 6W6 1.2.0
entry.summary: MPC/Force port of athousanddetails' schwung-6W6 TR-606 drum machine: voices fitted against real hardware recordings, with measured-partial hats and cymbal. Touchscreen skin and Q-Links.
